note: Mapping is source traceability, not a claim of resolution. Unmapped findings remain open unless explicitly superseded.

findings.summary: Two competing 'start' doors above the fold plus four more below
33 text nodes under 13 px on the landing page
'A new version of CrankMagic is ready. Reload' appears over the hero within seconds
The signed-in header says 'Open your decks' while the nav says 'Decks' and the door says 'DECKS · I have a commander in mind'
Sign in is one item in a 17-row menu that also holds Reset All
Sign-in gives no feedback: the page silently reloaded into Decks
'Term definitions on hover: On' is a toggle disguised as a menu row
Two 'New deck' entry points and a 'Bulk actions' button that is disabled with no explanation
'Six decks, all playable' was stale after creating a deck: the grid did not refresh until a filter was clicked
'New from Wizards' precon rail competes with the deck grid for the first column
Deck-select checkboxes are 18 px and only visible on hover; favorites star appears on hover only
Help '?' next to the page title opens prose
Five equal doors with no default or recommendation
Choosing a door silently creates a deck shell before anything is chosen
Four left-rail steps (Pick a commander, Choose colors, play style, mechanics) read as a wizard but are optional and never required
Next is disabled with no reason shown
Deck name field pre-fills 'New deck' and is above the commander field, so the name is asked before anything to name
Search shows one result row with no loading or no-results state
Selection is shown twice: the highlighted row and a repeated name line below it
'Next' closes the wizard and drops the player on an unchanged Decks grid
A one-card deck shows 'Playable at the table' and 'B2'
The action row offers Edit card list, Lock list, Log a game, Measure, More for a deck with one card
'Playable at the table · all 1 cards known' and a 'Play this deck' button on a one-card deck
Tabs carry counts as bare numbers ('The hundred 1', 'Acquire 1')
'Define the deck / Leave undefined' is a radio pair repeated at the top of all four sections
Radio and checkbox inputs are 13 to 16 px with a 42 px tall hit area on the label only
Budget ($) and 'Other restrictions' fields have no placeholder, format hint or default
The dialog re-centers vertically when a section changes height, so the left-rail items move under the pointer
Saltiness / Speed / Competitiveness are 1 to 5 selects with no anchor words
Primary composition is required but shows 'Choose…' with no required marker; failure is a dot on the tab
Sixty-five mechanic chips in an unordered wall, two pre-tagged 'commander'
Three radios (Auto-create, Merge in a Group, Define later) with no description of what each does
Weighting radios (Balanced, Offense, Defense, Response, Value, Combo) wrap to two rows with one orphan
Validation failure is a 6 px dot after 'Gameplay' and focus on the wrong field
'Remove' is the only action and it is disconnected from what it acts on
Card buttons carry 11 px labels; status words ('To buy', 'Bench') are 12 px under each tile
Summary bar mixes units: '63 of 63 seats filled · 36 lands · To buy $57.11 · Bench 17 · To buy 46 · Other decks 0'
No loading state while the 99 is generated; the dialog appeared after a pause with no spinner
The 'NEXT' band says 'Lock the list when it is settled' while the header says 'The table cannot play these yet: Bruna, Triplicate Titan, …'

Overview is five stacked panels (Next, Progress, Cost, Mana curve, Card type, Spells, How it plays, Upgrade path, About the commander, Simulation history, Record); the only two actions are at the bottom
The action-row Measure button's accessible name is 'Compare lists under the browser simulation' while its label is 'Measure'
54 text nodes under 13 px (chip row, stat captions, definition buttons at 12 px)
Progress is a small inline pill 'Measuring… seed 2 of 6 · 73 points so far' at the bottom of the page, and the page auto-navigated to the report when done
The report scores (73 of 100) but offers no path from a weak check to a change
'FIDELITY: MEDIUM · 2 cards the engine could not read played as blanks' does not name the cards
'Back to deck' is a link styled as a button at the far right, far from the breadcrumb; the first click at a scrolled position hit the fidelity box
Groups are named 'LOADING 53 · owned, not in the box yet' and 'RESERVED 47 · committed to take a seat'
Row actions are text pills ('put it in the box', 'To buy · empty seat') that look like status, and the primary per-row action (open the card) is the whole 1,258 px row
172 text nodes under 13 px and 79 targets under 24 px on this screen
Type-count row uses words as buttons ('Land: definition') that open glossary entries
Empty state is a sentence of instructions with no action
A tab whose only content is a paragraph and a button to another page

Three mode buttons (Navigate / Inspect / Select) plus a toolbar of Search catalog / Back / Reset view / Filters · lens, and a right pane with three tabs: the stage's one job (find a swap) is not the first thing on screen
Four 17 px '?' disclosures ('What is this universe of cards?', 'How the graph works', 'How these work')
No way back into the deck with a chosen swap: 'Add and/or buy…' adds, it does not replace a seat
Acquire is three numbers and two buttons that leave the deck page
The deck says 46 to buy / $69.99; the To buy tab says 66; the review said $57.11; the row group says '47 records · 47 copies · $69.99'
'Bought' is a green primary button on every row with no confirmation and a '…' menu beside it
'Back to Play Space' is a primary-sized button in the filter row and leads to a tabletop sorting view unrelated to buying
232 text nodes under 13 px and 96 targets under 24 px
A 'drawer' and 'sorting space' metaphor on the Library page, labeled 'Play Space'
More holds 23 items in four groups, including Measure and Share Deck which are stage actions
'Delete deck…' and 'Archive' sit in the same group as 'Rename' and 'Share'
Sharing is a dead end: a menu item that produces a red toast
The toast persists for minutes and overlaps the Progress card
First click on 'Lock list' gave no response for several seconds; the dialog appeared only after a Scryfall check failed
The dialog states 'Locked the list of Giada deck' in the past tense before Confirm is pressed
The action row changed to six buttons and the Next band reads 'add the 53 cards you already own (Ready to add), then buy 46 cards ($69.99), and 1 more step.'
Four stat cards of 10 numbers each sit above the 100-row sheet; the formula sentence sits between title and cards
'Do all available (53)' is the primary button and it mutates 53 ownership rows with no confirm
Rows read '— nothing comes out → PUT IN <card> · Bench · on the list, not yet in the box'
No 'box done' moment: after Do all available, nothing marks the deck Boxed or sends the player to Play
Three doors (New table, Choose a deck, Set up an AI game) plus an invitation field; 'Choose a deck' is a link that leaves Play
Three 'not connected yet' notices on one page (lounge chat, public discovery, leaderboard)
Seats are laid out 4-3 / 2-You, deck select and 'Set the table' are below the fold; name is required but unmarked
Validation toast 'Give your name at the table.' appears at the bottom, away from the empty field, with no field marking
Selecting a deck inserts a line 'You bring D6 Krenko to seat 1' above the seats, shifting the layout and moving the button under the pointer
'Ready' is a small 12 px button among Change deck / Choose mat; the Table rules card with Start sits in the middle of the mats
AI seat says 'Pending · Choosing a deck' with a green 'Choose its deck' button: the host must choose for the AI
The chooser lists 'Shared decks' and 'Your library decks' with the same decks appearing in both under different names (D3 Kiora vs D3 Kasmina, D5 Teysa Karlov vs D5 Shadrix)
The countdown is a 24 px number inside the rules card; the seats do not change
There is no way to concede, leave the table, or end the game from the board
The app sidebar (Decks, Library, Explore, Play, Menu) and the legal footer remain in the DOM under the board, focusable but hidden
Vital numbers are 12 px: life '40 ☠0' in the top bar (P41-C03, 60×19 px), turn/priority at 12 px, 'Opening hands' pill
'Actions' appears three times with three meanings: the left panel title, the top-right 'Actions' button (which toggles that panel), and 'All actions' inside it
'Pass' is the big center control but disabled during the opening hand; Keep/Mulligan are 12 px rows in the side panel
Two icon-only edge toggles ('Toggle board tools', 'Toggle table panel') render at font-size 0 with no visible label
Every action is a two-step (select, then Confirm) with an explanatory sentence each time
Playable cards in hand get a green outline, but the side-panel option list is the only place the action is named ('Play Mountain ×2')
'Settings' and 'Account & app settings' are two rows in the same menu
Collapsing the choices panel hides a pending decision behind a one-line note
Sliders have 11 px labels and no value readout for Tilt/Zoom/Cards beyond the number; 'Appearance preview · this device' is unexplained
Coach opens an empty chat with four prompt chips and a send box, but the Coach is a stub per AGENTS.md
'Game in progress · Rob · AI · Resume your table' is a small line inside the hero; the sidebar shows 'Game on · Turn 1 · Return'
'Your record 0 0 0' and 'Recent games: Your completed games will appear here' are the only results surfaces; the game-over screen was not reachable in this walk
Eleven fields with one required marker (Date); 'Finish', 'Your seat' default to 'Not recorded'; Bracket defaults to 2 regardless of the deck's bracket
Nothing in the form or after saving leads to a change: no 'dead card in hand → consider replacing' handoff
Table view opens with the choices panel collapsed; the pending decision survives only as 'Actions · choice pending' in the top bar
Hand strip legend 'Land 0/2 · Creature 0/2 · Instant 0/0 · Other 0/2' has no key, and the hand cards render at about 60 px
The central life dial (40 | 40) is the most prominent element but reads as decoration: no labels, no turn or priority indicator attached
Seat panels say 'AI · 40 ☠0 · Chulane, Teller of Tales · AI's hand · 7' and 'You · Rob · 40 ☠0 · Krenko, Mob Boss · Deciding'; the 3D view's seat headers use a different order and wording
Focus view hides the opponent entirely: no life, no board, no hand count for the AI seat
No visible way to switch seats or leave Focus; the seat 'Focus' buttons from Table view are gone and the only exit is the Camera menu
'0 mana open · land drop used' is the most useful status line on the board and it is 11 px in the corner

There is no Admin panel. Production and staging both answer 404 to /api/admin/*, /api/me carries no admin flag, and no route or control named Admin exists; the only owner-gated control is 'Invite to CrankMagic' on staging
'Profile' opens the Settings page, not a profile
Two pill buttons above a 17-row menu: the menu now has three visual grammars (pills, grouped rows, theme list)
Invite is a two-field form (Name, Email, Send) with no list of who has been invited, no state after Send, and no statement of what the invitee receives
The Budget card lists 30+ deck rows with Budget / Cost / Counts and dominates the right column above AI Coach, Data and the Danger zone
'Clear all data' is a one-click button with a caption ('Save a backup first.'); 'Delete account' asks for the typed address
'Reduce motion' and 'Stop at every step of my turn' are buttons whose on/off state is not visible
Settings is reached from three places with three labels: 'Settings' (menu), 'Profile' (pill), 'Account & app settings' (board avatar menu)
The Confirmations dialog has no controls: 'Every step still asks before it acts.' plus a note
The 'Actions' row is disabled with no reason, and the drag handles promised by the caption are not visible in the matrix
'Saved view preferences' fills the history (11 of the first 13 rows) and 'Undo last change' would undo a view preference rather than a library change
The seven tours are the best onboarding surface in the app and the only door to them is a menu row 17 rows deep
A targets question shows no source → effect → target relationship: the desk draws the acting card and lists the targets as text buttons
Focusing an opponent's board is a 14 px-tall link ('View AI's board, 40 life', 1345×14) in Full view and 59×24 '⤢ Focus' buttons at 11 px in Table view; no pointer gesture on the board itself
Side-pane modules have fixed heights; the only drag handle is the pane's width ('Actions and boards width: drag, or use the arrow keys', 12×797)
The Coach header on main is about four times the height it needs ('CrankMagic Coach · Sees your board, hand and the table · turn 1'); production's is one 49 px line
The four prompt chips are 11 px text in 26 px-tall targets; on main they are hidden altogether
Module reorder in edit mode relies on a six-dot drag handle that is small and does not work well; the ↑ ↓ buttons already do the job
Module headers are not toggles: collapsing a side-pane module is a separate 33×40 button at 12 px, and a collapsed module cannot be resized
Prepared: after the creature half resolves prepared, the option to cast the copy as its spell half is not offered (Studious First-Year)
The block draft is blocker-first with text pairs ('Goblin #486 → Dream Stalker #475 · Remove'), a 'Clear this blocker' button, 'All block options' and one Confirm for the whole draft
Target options name the card and append the controller as a suffix only for permanents that are not yours ('Smuggler's Copter (Keith's)'); nothing groups targets by player

During a targets question the desk's large image is the source card and the title repeats its name ('Reclamation Sage: choose one target …'); the affected card is only a text button, and a second Confirm / Clear step follows
Identical lands render as separate cards on the battlefield; #878 stacks identical options only inside a question
The lands / battlefield split within a board is fixed, while three other dimensions already drag (pane width, boards' widths, hand size)
